name: Estate sale company and auctioneer

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Consignment drop-off
services.story: A consignment drop-off or a free 15-minute evaluation. Nothing is taken. The gallery keeps 25% of what sells and settles the rest after the auction, its own way.

services.name: Written appraisal
services.story: A written appraisal at the office, 2-hour minimum $350; a card saved for the $50 missed-appointment fee; paid at the counter.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Estate sale
services.story: The main story: a free walk-through, then a managed estate sale: 35% of the gross, $1,500 minimum, taken from the proceeds; nothing up front. Lee Estate Sales settles it its own way within 14 days of the last sale day. Rosie sends nothing about money.

services.name: Estate sale
services.story: A cleanout quoted at the walk-through when there's no sale: $900, nothing up front, billed through Rosie after the job.

services.name: Written appraisal
services.story: A written appraisal at the home, $175 an hour with a 2-hour minimum ($350); billed after.

services_shape: Project: a free walk-through at the home, then a written proposal, a signed agreement, setup days, sale days and a settlement; the firm is paid a share of what sells, settled from the proceeds in its own tools, not through Rosie
questions_before_times: What is being sold or cleared: the whole home, a few rooms, or single items?
Who has the right to sell: the owner, an executor or administrator, a trustee, an agent under a power of attorney, or a conservator?
Any date the home must be empty by: a closing, a lease end or a listing
Is the home owned, rented or in a building with rules? (a public sale in a rented or condo home needs the building's OK)
safety_stop: someone is hurt, has fallen or can't breathe
a fire, smoke or a gas smell
license: an auctioneer license where the state's rules license auctioneers (each auctioneer, the firm, or both); a bond and a trust account for buyers' money where those rules require them (the business's own bookkeeping); an estate sale firm usually needs only a business registration; a used-goods dealer license, a seller's permit and a per-sale local permit only where the rules require them
messages_never: ["Lockbox and gate codes","Item lists, item values and the settlement amount: the secure page only","That a home stands empty: told only to the staff on the job","A death, health details or the family's situation: owner and staff texts never say why a home is being sold"]
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
